attributions.surface_quote: to win or fail, and either, like Sisyphus, run again the weary course, or else inherit hard-won entrance to unconditional being.

canonical_statement: A specific 'Path' exists for spiritual advancement, requiring balanced conduct.

attributions.chapter: YE SHALL REAP AS YE HAVE SOWN. THE PERCEPTION
attributions.surface_quote: It is the sharp, knife-edge Path, whereon all things so evenly balance that there is turning neither to the right nor left, but steady, even pursuit of the Path

canonical_statement: Those who achieve worthiness can attain resurrection from materiality without further incarnation.

attributions.chapter: YE SHALL REAP AS YE HAVE SOWN. THE PERCEPTION
attributions.surface_quote: Those who shall be accounted worthy, without further incarnation, to obtain the resurrection from the body of materiality

canonical_statement: Negative actions result in karmic consequences, leading to further incarnations until the spiritual path is found.

attributions.chapter: YE SHALL REAP AS YE HAVE SOWN. THE PERCEPTION
attributions.surface_quote: karmic woe will attend the offender until he finds the Path and travels therein.

canonical_statement: The state of 'Being' is eternal, without beginning or end, and exists outside the dominion of time.

attributions.surface_quote: Being, which hath no beginning, neither end, and is not under the dominion of Time

canonical_statement: Every individual ego originates from the Father and possesses eternal 'Being'.

attributions.surface_quote: every ego hath ever from the Father

canonical_statement: 'Life' is a finite state, having both a beginning and an end.

attributions.surface_quote: Life hath beginning, so also it must have end; it hath end.

canonical_statement: If the conditions of 'Life' permanently bind the soul, it is diverted from its 'ego' and becomes subject to death.

attributions.surface_quote: If its conditions are strong enough to enchain for aye, then the soul is diverted from its ego to the tracks of Life, and is then heritor of death.

canonical_statement: A soul avoids death only if it maintains its connection to 'Being' and its 'ego' rather than forfeiting it to 'Life'.

attributions.surface_quote: Only if a soul forfeit not to Life its hold on Being-on its ego-shall it not die.

canonical_statement: Sin is defined as the error of turning away from 'Being' and towards 'Life', which leads to death.

attributions.surface_quote: Sin is the error of turning from Being unto Life, whereof the shadow is death.

canonical_statement: A soul that persists in sin and does not turn away from finite 'life' will experience death.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul that sinneth and turneth not away from finite life and the conditions thereof, it shall die.

canonical_statement: Achieving a state of being 'karmaless' and 'immortal' signifies the end of the need for reincarnation.

attributions.surface_quote: karmaless, immortal, beside Jesus, no more need to incarnate

canonical_statement: The 'Book of Life' is an imperishable record containing all events, sights, sounds, shapes, and things.

attributions.surface_quote: the record of the Book of Life, mirror of all events, sights, sounds, shapes, all things.

canonical_statement: Beings who are 'karmaless' and 'deathless' are one with the 'Father of Being' and possess his knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: We can do this, because we are karmaless, deathless, and are at one with the Father of Being, seeing, knowing as he knows, because He is in us.

canonical_statement: Individual identity can persist across multiple incarnations, with a soul's 'individuality' being reborn into different physical forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Lolix's individuality was Elizabeth's (my wife).

canonical_statement: Karma is a precise and inevitable system of recompense for actions, ensuring that errors are met with appropriate consequences.

attributions.surface_quote: our errors required it, and Karma is a sure paymaster.

canonical_statement: A 'devachan' is a state or realm where a soul's dreams or desires can be realized after physical death.

attributions.surface_quote: In her Poseid devachan she had found her dream of life seem realized.

canonical_statement: The soul's journey involves an upward progression towards 'immortal heights' or a divine state, often through overcoming challenges.

attributions.surface_quote: Man's course upward to God is so blind... till at last I had gained the immortal heights.

canonical_statement: All events, regardless of their apparent scale, are subject to an underlying order.

attributions.surface_quote: All things, small or great, are ordered.

canonical_statement: The concept of 'accident' is merely a limited perspective on a larger, inherent design or order.

attributions.surface_quote: To the greater vision, accident is but an are of design, and disorder is but an arc of order.

canonical_statement: Actions performed in the present or recent past can directly influence immediate future outcomes.

attributions.surface_quote: sometimes from one's last year's or yesterday's action the fruit springs.

canonical_statement: The principle of 'whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap' governs the cause and effect of life.

attributions.surface_quote: the lesson of life was, 'whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap,' cause and effect.

canonical_statement: There is no true randomness or 'accident' in existence.

attributions.surface_quote: There is no accident in life

canonical_statement: Historical events and past civilizations are recorded in astral records, accessible through perfected spiritual vision.

attributions.surface_quote: ancient site...to be known as the haunt of man only through the clear vision of the perfected eyes which scan astral records.

canonical_statement: The fall of advanced civilizations is a consequence of human iniquity.

attributions.surface_quote: And all this to perish because of man's iniquity, a few short hundreds of years later.

canonical_statement: The total number of individual souls or 'Human Rays' in existence is fixed and finite.

attributions.surface_quote: only a fixed number of Human Rays went forth from the Father, and only so many have Life, or ever will have.

canonical_statement: Souls cycle between earthly incarnation and a non-physical state called 'devachan'.

attributions.surface_quote: as a soul comes to Earth (having been in devachan) a soul passes from Earth into devachan.

canonical_statement: The number of incarnated souls on Earth fluctuates, but the overall pool of souls remains constant.

attributions.surface_quote: There are a varying number of people always in the world; now more, now less; for as a soul comes to Earth...a soul passes from Earth...

canonical_statement: The moral and spiritual state of humanity directly influences the natural world and its condition.

attributions.surface_quote: when manhood suffers decadence, degradation, all nature with which he has to do also sensibly alters for the worse.

canonical_statement: Technological advancements from a past era will be rediscovered in a future era.

attributions.surface_quote: the men of the twentieth century shall find them all again.

canonical_statement: A specific future event will involve an ascension of individuals to escape a cataclysmic destruction of the Earth.

attributions.surface_quote: caught up 'into the heavens' to escape the end of all things, when the earth also... shall be burned up.

canonical_statement: Moral corruption originates from an external malevolent entity.

attributions.surface_quote: The seeds of corruption sown in the hearts of men by the Evil One

canonical_statement: Divine qualities can manifest through human appearance, suggesting a connection between the human and the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: a light almost divine in the power of its transfiguring beauty. Her slight figure seemed not so much of Earth as of Heaven.

canonical_statement: The astral record of events is eternally preserved and accessible to those with psychic perception.

attributions.surface_quote: the astral record of which rings yet, and forever, for those who have ears to hear such psychic tones

canonical_statement: The divine entity, Incal, does not accept blood sacrifice or symbolic substitutions of the innocent for the guilty.

attributions.surface_quote: Incal, God, will never take blood of anything, nor symbol of any sort which placeth an innocent in a guilty one's stead!

canonical_statement: The 'Unfed Light' is a destructive force that instantly consumes sacrifices.

attributions.surface_quote: the Unfed Light doth truly destroy it instantly.

canonical_statement: The individual identity can persist across multiple incarnations over vast spans of time.

attributions.surface_quote: Me, even me, they slew, for trying to stem the tide of depravity and ecclesiastical criminality. I repeated to them the prophecy of the Maxin, and they heeded not, but slew me. For that woman was my personality when I reincarnated, three thousand years after thou, as Zailm, did leave me, as Anzimee.

canonical_statement: Harm to humanity is harm to the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: no man can injure God except through injuring Man.

canonical_statement: Individual souls can be reunited, indicating a shared or singular spiritual essence.

attributions.surface_quote: our Spirit was one reunited

canonical_statement: Actions in one life determine consequences in future lives, a principle of karmic retribution.

attributions.surface_quote: they have suffered for it, and yet shall suffer, for it is their karma.

canonical_statement: Souls reincarnate to atone for past transgressions, implying a process of spiritual purification.

attributions.surface_quote: tares were sown with the good wheat when next those souls reincarnated. And they have had to glean and uproot as they could, and so must continue to tear up the evil weeds till every one be uprooted. Then will they have atoned unto God.

canonical_statement: There is an abundance of time and lives available for spiritual progression and atonement.

attributions.surface_quote: There is time enough, lives enough, but O friends, none to waste!

canonical_statement: Prophecies of destruction can be fulfilled through cataclysmic natural events.

attributions.surface_quote: the day of destruction is at hand which was foretold ages age! Atlan shall won be no more beheld by the sun in his whole course for the sea shall swallow you all!

canonical_statement: A power of righteousness exists that is destined to overcome corruption and sin.

attributions.surface_quote: there really was a power of right which was destined to bring the corruption of Poseid low

canonical_statement: The soul can depart the body due to intense fear and not return, resulting in death.

attributions.surface_quote: his soul had gone forth from his body in desperate fear, to return no more

canonical_statement: Divine or higher beings can provide revelations to individuals.

attributions.surface_quote: Nepth, had a revelation. It came from the Sons of the Solitude

canonical_statement: Prophecies of doom, even if ancient, can be re-revealed with renewed force.

attributions.surface_quote: repetition of the prophecy of doom... bore to Nepth all the force of a new revelation

canonical_statement: The physical world is subject to catastrophic geological transformations.

attributions.surface_quote: the earth shook and trembled in a frightful manner. Rivers left their beds... mountains shook till they were left as hills

canonical_statement: Prophecy can accurately foretell future events.

attributions.surface_quote: not knowing just when the dread prophecy was to be fulfilled.

canonical_statement: Human actions and beliefs can determine one's fate during cataclysmic events.

attributions.surface_quote: thou wouldst never believe in other days. I told thee then this land should sink... Now go thy way

canonical_statement: The physical world is subject to catastrophic geological transformations.

attributions.surface_quote: the lands left unflooded began to sink. With never a pause... all things sank, down, down, down

canonical_statement: Humanity's survival is contingent upon adaptation and the preservation of cultural memory.

attributions.surface_quote: A very few other people had been similarly forced seawards... founded the race which, repopulating that land

canonical_statement: Ancient civilizations and their practices can influence future cultures and societies.

attributions.surface_quote: retained the name, slightly modified, so as to be Inca, a name bestowed upon their rulers.

canonical_statement: Individual souls reincarnate across different historical periods and identities.

attributions.surface_quote: Rai Gwauxln was come to be Mendocus, while Rai Ernon of Suern was with us now, Mol Lang. Sohma was that, Son of the Solitude whom I took on my vailx when I was Zailm, away from Suern. So we saw the interweaving of the life lines.

canonical_statement: A 'Christ-Spirit' is an eternal, singular consciousness that incarnates as various enlightened figures throughout history.

attributions.surface_quote: We knew him for the Christ, illumining man then, and later as Buddha, and again overshining that greater than Buddha, the Nazarene. 'Before Abraham was, I am.'

canonical_statement: Any individual who fully embodies the 'Christ-Spirit' becomes a 'Son of God' and achieves spiritual equality with other enlightened beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Whosoever the Christ-Spirit entereth into and abideth in, becometh a Son of God, and equal with Gautama

canonical_statement: Embodiment of the 'Christ-Spirit' is conditional upon following a specific spiritual 'Path'.

attributions.surface_quote: into no one will it enter who doth not travel the Path.

canonical_statement: Past interactions between souls can predetermine future events and roles, such as one soul becoming an instrument of mercy for another.

attributions.surface_quote: because Mainin had crossed our life then, I was thereby made the instrument of mercy to him by Christ, and that occasion was yet to come.

canonical_statement: Individual identities can persist across vast spans of time and through multiple incarnations.

attributions.surface_quote: that individuality of twenty-three thousand years ago is now Sohma.

canonical_statement: The will of divine entities can be communicated through human intermediaries.

attributions.chapter: FIRST SACRIFICE OF SELF FOR LOVE OF ANOTHER
attributions.surface_quote: The gods say that the girl also must die.

canonical_statement: Refusal to comply with divine will results in the cessation of individual existence.

attributions.chapter: FIRST SACRIFICE OF SELF FOR LOVE OF ANOTHER
attributions.surface_quote: thou mayest not avoid this sacrifice and live, say the gods.

canonical_statement: The act of sacrifice can be a means of appeasing divine entities.

attributions.chapter: FIRST SACRIFICE OF SELF FOR LOVE OF ANOTHER
attributions.surface_quote: Accept, ye gods, this sacrifice.

canonical_statement: The essence of identity persists beyond physical death.

attributions.chapter: FIRST SACRIFICE OF SELF FOR LOVE OF ANOTHER
attributions.surface_quote: What personality was he, was the girl, dead from horror? Myself! and Phyris!

canonical_statement: The soul undergoes a cycle of rebirths into different physical forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Then again rebirth, and through a karma not here to be explained, the new man had ease, wealth, plenty.

canonical_statement: Actions and experiences from past lives determine conditions and challenges in subsequent lives.

attributions.surface_quote: through a karma not here to be explained, the new man had ease, wealth, plenty. But a physical karma pursued...

canonical_statement: Moral development requires interaction with others in the physical world.

attributions.surface_quote: my individuality lost opportunities to cultivate moral strength by worldly contact

canonical_statement: Every life experience is composed of both positive and negative aspects.

attributions.surface_quote: So every life-karma is made up of sunshine and shadow.

canonical_statement: The principle of karma includes both retribution and positive reciprocation.

attributions.surface_quote: "A tooth for a tooth?" Yea! But also "for a kiss a kiss."

canonical_statement: Advanced psychic abilities allow individuals to transcend physical limitations and perform actions remotely.

attributions.surface_quote: learned it was possible to divest themselves of the flesh, and in astral body go whither they would

canonical_statement: Mastery of psychic abilities confers invulnerability to physical laws as applied by those with lesser psychic power.

attributions.surface_quote: master of psychics is invulnerable to the laws of physicality when wielded by men less than he

canonical_statement: Societal decline is initiated by a deterioration in the education of its populace.

attributions.surface_quote: Whenever earth's nations shall cease to educate the coming generation, decay shall begin.

canonical_statement: Civilizations rise and fall in cyclical patterns.

attributions.surface_quote: Poseid arose, flourished and decayed, in the fullness of cyclic times.

canonical_statement: Present-day nations can be reincarnations of past civilizations.

attributions.surface_quote: America is Poseid come again, reincarnated.

canonical_statement: Souls from past civilizations can reincarnate into future ones.

attributions.surface_quote: successive enfleshment of those souls which in Atla, made that land proud.

canonical_statement: Societal development can involve the evolution of a 'soul-element' within its people.

attributions.surface_quote: America hath developed that soul-element which, when her people were Poseidi, was first faintly traced.

canonical_statement: The ultimate union of masculine and feminine soul elements results in a perfect, unified being, an androgyne spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: The reunion of the semi-egoii...the souls of the feminine and masculine elements become on the same plane; both are perfect.

canonical_statement: In the state of ultimate union, two individual consciousnesses merge to think, will, and express identically and simultaneously, becoming one being with dual aspects.

attributions.surface_quote: each thinks, wills and expresses itself the same in all ways simultaneously, the two alter egoii are then one

canonical_statement: The Spirit, or 'I AM,' is an eternally undivided entity that illuminates each soul equally.

attributions.surface_quote: receive the Spirit, or I AM, which was always undivided, and which illumined each soul of its pair equally.

canonical_statement: The perfection attained by unified beings is a perfection of a part, distinct from the Conditionless Being of the Father.

attributions.surface_quote: not perfect as our Father is, for He is perfect as Conditionless Being, but our perfection is that of a part

canonical_statement: All beings are components of God, but God is not a component of any individual being.

attributions.surface_quote: we are all of God, but not He of any one of us.

canonical_statement: The attainment of perfection does not lead to annihilation.

attributions.surface_quote: were this not true, then our attainment of perfection...would find in its realization annihilation.

canonical_statement: The soul that deviates from its purpose faces a cycle of repeated existence until it achieves perfection.

attributions.surface_quote: only the soul that sins is cast into the second death, fated to the Sisyphic round till it does succeed.

canonical_statement: Individual parts of existence are inherently drawn towards the totality of existence, which is the source of being.

attributions.surface_quote: because we each axe parts, therefore are we forever attracted to the Father, who is sum of all parts

canonical_statement: True death does not exist, only the cessation of connection to the Whole.

attributions.surface_quote: there is no death, save in defying and abandoning all hold on the Whole.

canonical_statement: The perfection of an individual part contributes to the perfection of the Whole, and the Whole depends on its parts.

attributions.surface_quote: Perfection of a part but draws it nearer to the Whole, and perfection of the Whole compels It to depend on each of Its parts.

canonical_statement: While personality can be extinguished, the Spirit, originating from the Father, is immortal.

attributions.surface_quote: extinction of personality, the erring soul may perish... but the Spirit from the Father dieth not.

canonical_statement: To achieve eternal life for the soul, one must align it with the divine will and serve the Creator.

attributions.surface_quote: If for thy soul thou wouldst have eternal life... then subdue it, subdue thy soul, at--one it to God

canonical_statement: Serving one's own soul leads to its loss and the necessity of creating a new one.

attributions.surface_quote: But if thou serve it thou shalt lose it and have to make another during coming aeons.

canonical_statement: Prophecy is only possible in a universe that is not Godless.

attributions.surface_quote: Prophecy would be impossible in a Godless universe

canonical_statement: Vibration is the fundamental law governing all other laws.

attributions.surface_quote: vibration is the law of laws

canonical_statement: The principle of vibration enables minds to connect with the Creator and divine ministers.

attributions.surface_quote: vibration is the law of laws, no mind could come into unison with the Creator

canonical_statement: Every living being serves as a minister to the creature directly below it in a hierarchical structure.

attributions.surface_quote: each living being is minister to the creature immediately inferior

canonical_statement: Existence is structured into cycles, and a significant transition or 'Great Divide' marks the end of one cycle and the beginning of another.

attributions.surface_quote: The Division of the Way Hath Come; the Midnight Hour of the Cycle Which, More Than Any Other, Formed Life's Great Divide, Hath Struck.

canonical_statement: A divine entity initiates a renewal of all things at the culmination of a cycle.

attributions.surface_quote: now for some seconds hath been fulfilled the initiation of that saying of Him who sitteth upon the throne: "Behold! I make all things new."

canonical_statement: Individuals who persevere in a specific spiritual path will inherit divine favor and a transformed state of being.

attributions.surface_quote: the one overcoming shall inherit all things and I will he his God, and he shall be my son.

canonical_statement: Those who are morally corrupt, unbelieving, or deviate from truth will experience a 'second death' or significant negative karmic consequence at the end of an age.

attributions.surface_quote: But as for the cowards... and the unbelievers... and the abominable... their portion is the (Great Karma of the World) second death.

canonical_statement: At the end of an age, there is a separation of individuals based on their spiritual preparedness and adherence to truth.

attributions.surface_quote: These are they who separate at the Dividing of the Way, going in the finite direction, not having the Spirit (7), and are placed as an example, to endure the retributive justice of an age-ending fire.

canonical_statement: Civilizations can reincarnate or return on higher planes of existence, carrying forward both their glories and their karmic consequences.

attributions.surface_quote: America is Atlantis come again, returned on a higher plane, enduring woes and retracing glories.

canonical_statement: Time progresses in cycles, and at the end of each cycle, imperfections are judged against the standard of Truth.

attributions.surface_quote: Another cycle hath reached its end... All that which is imperfect... face judgment by the standard, Truth.

canonical_statement: Karmic penalties are inescapable once their full time is set, and past actions determine future outcomes.

attributions.surface_quote: Aught cannot be amended to escape karmic penalty, for its full time is set.

canonical_statement: The Great Karma ensures that those who act unjustly are returned to a state preceding their deviation from human nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The Great Karma setteth each evildoer back to the point attained ere animal forces obtained control.

canonical_statement: Actions in the present
The suffering and destruction at the end of an age are not divine punishment but the natural consequence of humanity's choices and actions.

attributions.surface_quote: no supernatural penalty, no capricious infliction by an offended personal God... It is all of Man's own doing.

canonical_statement: Humanity's deviation from its inherent divine nature, characterized by self-worship and materialism, leads to societal decline and suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: He hath wandered from the Way, and hath for the God-nature in him... substituted worship of Self and of Mammon.

canonical_statement: The universe and natural world reflect the state and nature of humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: Man is the type and the universe is the print; Nature patterns after Man, not Man after Nature.

canonical_statement: Humanity possesses free will, and its choices determine its future experiences and consequences.

attributions.surface_quote: He, a being, of free-will, hath brought all coming woes of judgment to be inevitable; he must endure; as he hath sown, so must he reap.

canonical_statement: The current era is a repetition of patterns observed at the end of previous ages, such as Poseid.

attributions.surface_quote: All of this... has been so at the ending of every age, was so in Poseid and is therefore now repeated.

canonical_statement: The current period marks a significant divergence in the timeline of existence, after which past patterns will not recur.

attributions.surface_quote: But it can never be so again after this, for HERE THE WAY DIVIDES.

canonical_statement: A future event, referred to as 'the Reaper,' will involve a cleansing by fire, from which only those with changed hearts will be safe.

attributions.surface_quote: In the full time by fire the Reaper shall reap, and no place be found for physical safety by the unchanged of heart.

canonical_statement: The duration of this future cleansing will be shortened to prevent the complete annihilation of life.

attributions.surface_quote: But the time of it shall be foreshortened, else no flesh could remain alive.

canonical_statement: Retribution for past actions is inevitable and cannot be prevented or modified.

attributions.surface_quote: No more is there any chance to prevent the coming retribution... Too late is it to even modify the result...

canonical_statement: The collective moral state of humanity directly influences the physical conditions and natural phenomena of the Earth.

attributions.surface_quote: Nature follows Man. Wherefore the waters of Earth will dry out... all this will occur only through natural causes, and in consonance with the selfishness...

canonical_statement: Humanity's selfishness, lust, greed, anger, and general depravity are the underlying causes of societal collapse and natural disasters.

attributions.surface_quote: all this will occur only through natural causes, and in consonance with the selfishness, lust, greed, anger and general depravity of the Type.

canonical_statement: The current era is the close of a cycle, marked by a decline in love and an increase in selfishness.

attributions.surface_quote: the love that should grace and soften men's hearts... dried up and became a mockery in the close of the ended cycle

canonical_statement: The principle of 'Capital' (selfishness) compels a power dynamic where a few dominate the many, contradicting an inherent truth of human equality.

attributions.surface_quote: Capital, which, itself merely the natural fruit of selfishness... compelling the few to be masters of the many, denying the God-born declaration that all men are created free and equal

canonical_statement: The culmination of an age is preceded by specific signs and events.

attributions.surface_quote: When you see surrounded by encampments the Jerusalem, then you may know that has come near the desolation.

canonical_statement: The concept of 'Jerusalem' represents a 'Vision of Peace'.

attributions.surface_quote: know ye the meaning of the name Jerusalem? That it meaneth 'Vision of Peace?'

canonical_statement: Actions in the present determine future consequences, a principle of reaping what is sown.

attributions.surface_quote: As ye have sown, so must ye reap.

canonical_statement: There is an inner spiritual entity that urges the soul towards higher development.

attributions.surface_quote: the inward Spirit beseeches the soul to go up higher.

canonical_statement: Omission of spiritual action or neglect of salvation incurs negative consequences.

attributions.surface_quote: Omission too, hath its penalty: 'How shall we escape if we neglect so great salvation?'

canonical_statement: Those who embody 'the Cross' (live righteously) are exempt from suffering and karmic expiation, even in bodily death.

attributions.surface_quote: There were and are those who lived and live the Cross. These shall not suffer, not even though bodily death overtake them; they have no Karma to expiate.

canonical_statement: The Divine stream of Life, which is God, is the long arm of the Living Cross.

attributions.surface_quote: the Divine stream of Life, the Indefinable God, that is, the long arm of the Living Cross.

canonical_statement: Purposed Human Will constitutes the short arm of the Living Cross.

attributions.surface_quote: Directed, purposed Human Will is the short arm.

canonical_statement: The lower self, or animal nature, exists within humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: This self is the lower self; it is the animal. All animals are in man concreted.

canonical_statement: The human soul can be enslaved by the animal nature.

attributions.surface_quote: his human soul is enslaved to the animal.

canonical_statement: Animal nature is undirected force, whether embodied or not.

attributions.surface_quote: Animal is only force undirected, whether it exist in a body or not.

canonical_statement: When animal nature is directed by will, it ceases to be animal.

attributions.surface_quote: Directed, guided by will, it ceaseth to be animal.

canonical_statement: The Divine Stream, which is causeless and contains all things, flows from unknown origins to unknown destinations.

attributions.surface_quote: Causeless, Divine Stream which containeth all things and floweth no man knoweth whence nor whither.

canonical_statement: The 'little child' of the Spirit will rule the inner 'menagerie' of man in the New Time.

attributions.surface_quote: the 'little child' of the Spirit in the New Time shall be ruler over the menagerie within the man

canonical_statement: In the New Time, no beast, regardless of form, will be free to do evil.

attributions.surface_quote: in the New Time no longer shall any beast, whether in human form, or in lower animal body, or merely apparent as a raging tempest or a disease, be free to do evil.

canonical_statement: The Spirit within an individual has the capacity to govern and transform lower, unbridled aspects of the self.

attributions.surface_quote: When the Spirit in Man cometh fully to its own, 'he shall rule them as with a rod of iron,' this riotous throng.

canonical_statement: Existence in a future era will necessitate a spiritual mode of perception and interaction with reality.

attributions.surface_quote: TO-DAY existence will demand a spiritual eye, and ear, and that every sense be raised to the Heights.

canonical_statement: No individual consciousness can be permanently lost or annihilated, as all are ultimately transformed by a divine process.

attributions.surface_quote: Not one can be lost, finally, of the evildoers, for God wastes nothing. He converts all things from lower into higher, inexorably, surely.

canonical_statement: Divine wrath is an expression of love's severity, serving as a catalyst for transfiguration and retributive justice.

attributions.surface_quote: Some must endure the retributive justice of the Great Karma, aye., the majority must experience more or less of this fire of transfiguration; the wrath of God is Love's severity.

canonical_statement: Every individual consciousness has a designated place within the divine order, ensuring none are truly lost.

attributions.surface_quote: Yet never shall a soul be lost; God hath place for everyone.

canonical_statement: The exercise of spiritual power without spiritual alignment leads to negative karmic consequences.

attributions.surface_quote: people... will abuse their privileges, having not the Spirit, and these sinful ones will the Perfect in Evil assail, that karma shall overtake them.

canonical_statement: The intensity of karmic atonement is proportional to the spiritual gifts or knowledge received.

attributions.surface_quote: Having had much given unto them, of them shall much be demanded, wherefore their karmic atonement will be more intense.

canonical_statement: Divine wrath is an expression of divine love, serving a corrective purpose.

attributions.surface_quote: The wrath of God is love's severity.

canonical_statement: All beings are destined for spiritual evolution from lower to higher states.

attributions.surface_quote: All shall be converted from lower into higher.

canonical_statement: A future golden age of humanity, characterized by greatness, freedom, and equality, is inevitable.

attributions.surface_quote: A glory shines across the coming years, The glory of a race grown great and free... A shining shore is by the Future's sea, Whereon each man all stand among his peers As equal.
